info.title: Tuition Media API
info.description:
Backend for Tuition Media. Every path is under `/api/v1`. Send the access token from `POST /api/v1/auth/google` as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Errors share one body (`ErrorResponse`); match on `code`.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable error code. Match on this.

details.description: Ids related to the error. Omitted on masked 5xx responses.

issues.description: One entry per zod issue. Sent only with VALIDATION_ERROR.

post.summary: Sign in or sign up with Google
post.description:
Verifies the Google ID token. Sign-up sends role (and optionally consentVersion); sign-in omits role. An unknown Google account with no role gets 404. A blocked account, or a deleted account signing in without a role, gets 403. An unknown Google account with an open admin invite (no role, or role ADMIN) and a verified email becomes an ACTIVE admin; 403 if the inviter is no longer an active super admin; 409 if the invite was used or revoked at the same moment. Returns an access token and a refresh token.

**Who:** Public.

**Rate limit:** global 100/min.

Listed tutors only (isListed). Filters: area, subject, gender, rating (minimum), name (contains, case-insensitive), district (name, case-insensitive; a tutor with any area in it), recent=true (joined in the last 90 days). Order: rating, then review count, then newest, then id. Without limit every match is returned. get.description:
Tutor browse (#46). OPEN requirements from ACTIVE students. scope=nearby matches requirements whose student pin is inside one of the tutor's zones, or whose area is in the tutor's service areas; scope=all skips the location match. scope=set lists the requirements that the matching engine pairs with one of the tutor's own active sets (setId, required); each row carries match {score, reasons}, and matchVersion is the config version. sort=newest (default) keeps newest first with a keyset cursor; sort=match (scope=set only) ranks by score, best first, then newest, capped at 300 with an offset cursor. scope=invited lists the OPEN requirements the tutor was invited to, newest invite first. The manual filters (curriculum, levelCode, subjectId, areaId) apply to nearby and all only. Every row has invitedAt. gaps explains an empty set page. noServiceArea is true when the tutor has no zones and no areas.
